title: Put authority and recovery before the side effect
description: Choose a consequential action, automation posture, and safeguards. The boundary trace shows whether the system preserves informed choice, review, and a route to recovery.

authorityModes.label: Recommend
authorityModes.description: The system proposes an action and explains it; an authorized person decides.

authorityModes.label: Prepare, then confirm
authorityModes.description: The system prepares the effect, but explicit human confirmation crosses the boundary.

authorityModes.label: Execute automatically
authorityModes.description: The system crosses the boundary without a case-by-case human confirmation.

scenarios.label: Optional personalization
scenarios.description: Use behavioral data to personalize a service that still works without personalization.
scenarios.effect: Begin collecting and using optional behavioral data.
scenarios.consequence: The person may be tracked for a purpose that is not required to deliver the core service.
scenarios.recoveryLabel: Withdraw the choice and stop future optional processing

scenarios.label: Delete a shared workspace
scenarios.description: Remove records that several people depend on for ongoing work.
scenarios.effect: Schedule deletion of user-controlled shared data.
scenarios.consequence: A mistaken or unauthorized deletion can cause broad and lasting data loss.
scenarios.recoveryLabel: Cancel during the delay or restore from a tested recovery path

scenarios.label: AI-assisted fraud hold
scenarios.description: A model flags a payment and proposes restricting an account.
scenarios.effect: Restrict access to funds while the case is reviewed.
scenarios.consequence: A false positive can block essential activity and disproportionately harm affected people.
scenarios.recoveryLabel: Escalate to an accountable reviewer and restore access when overturned

scenarios.label: Submit a benefit application
scenarios.description: Finalize user-provided financial and household information for an eligibility decision.
scenarios.effect: Commit an important submission and issue a reference.
scenarios.consequence: Incorrect data can delay a decision or create an avoidable correction process.
scenarios.recoveryLabel: Correct the submission through a documented amendment route

safeguards.label: Purpose-specific notice
safeguards.description: Explain what data is used, for which purpose, and what changes for the person.

safeguards.label: Specific affirmative choice
safeguards.description: Ask separately for the optional purpose instead of bundling it with core service access.

safeguards.label: Refusal preserves the core service
safeguards.description: Declining an optional purpose does not block unrelated essential functionality.

safeguards.label: Review before commit
safeguards.description: Show the exact effect and let the person correct inputs before finalization.

safeguards.label: Named decision owner
safeguards.description: An accountable role, not an anonymous system, owns the consequential decision.

safeguards.label: Reason and supporting evidence
safeguards.description: Expose the basis, uncertainty, and evidence needed for a meaningful review.

safeguards.label: Reachable human escalation
safeguards.description: A person can move the case to an authorized reviewer with enough context to act.

safeguards.label: Appeal or challenge path
safeguards.description: The affected person can contest the outcome and add corrective evidence.

safeguards.label: Durable receipt
safeguards.description: Record what was authorized, when, by whom, and how to revisit the action.

safeguards.label: Revoke, undo, or amend
safeguards.description: Provide a bounded recovery mechanism appropriate to the side effect.

safeguards.label: Reviewable audit evidence
safeguards.description: Preserve inputs, policy version, decision, and later corrections without exposing unnecessary data.
